desc: Derive math: answer = Σ_c valSum_c · H_{-c}, where H_{-c} = Σ_k k!(N-1-k)!·E_k^{(-c)}, E from P(x)=Π_c(1+q_c x)^{n_c}; per-class exclusion = polynomial division by (1+q_c x) in O(N). Verified on N=3 → 1332.
Implement input parsing and class stats: n_c counts, valSum_c (mod p), q_c = 10^c mod p for digit-lengths 1..len(str(N)).
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N mod 998244353.
Build factor polynomials F_c[k] = C(n_c,k)·q_c^k (k=0..n_c) using factorials.
Implement numpy int64 NTT + polynomial multiply with naive fallback; product-tree multiply all F_c → P (degree N).
For each class c with n_c>0: divide P by (1+q_c x) via Q[k]=P[k]-q_c·Q[k-1]; H_c = Σ_k Q[k]·fact[k]·fact[N-1-k] mod p.
Answer = Σ_c valSum_c·H_c mod p; print. Handle N=1 edge (answer 1).

Audit numpy NTT in-place butterfly aliasing bug (fixed with .copy()); verified bit-reversal, roots, inverse scaling, negative-mod handling; hand-traced N=1 → 1 and N=3 → 1332; assessed performance at N=2·10^5 (two 2^18 NTT multiplications, fast with numpy).
